tagline: Find where your harvest loses value.

notConfigured: This build has no Supabase settings. Copy .env.example to .env and fill it in.
name: Name
chooseFarmerCrop: Choose a farmer and a crop.
cratesInvalid: Crates must be a whole number of 1 or more.
cameraUnavailable: The camera is not available. Use the phone camera; this photo will be marked.
aiRead: Read from the photo: {{kg}} kg. Check it.
aiUnreadable: Could not read the display. Please type the weight.
qualityNote: A visible estimate, not a certified grade. You can change it.
queueUserNote: Items stay on this phone until the person who captured them signs in again.

reportInvalid: This report link is not valid.

weatherUnavailable: Weather data unavailable for this segment.
telegramHint: Open the link and press Start.

demoLoading: Working… this can take a minute.
teamIntro: Add the people who use LossMap in your organisation. They sign in with their email and a temporary password that you give them in person.
tempPasswordHint: Shown only once. Give it to the person privately; they should choose their own password after signing in.
staffResetConfirm: Reset the password for {{name}}? Their old password stops working.
staffDisableConfirm: Disable {{name}}? They lose access to all data straight away and cannot use LossMap until you enable them again.
staffErr_invalid: Check the name, email address and role, then try again.
staffErr_email_taken: That email already has an account.
staffErr_cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable your own account.
staffErr_last_manager: At least one active manager is needed.
staffErr_daily_limit: Too many team changes today. Try again tomorrow.
staffErr_demo_org: Team management is turned off in the demo.
staffErr_network: You are offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
staffErr_failed: Could not complete that. Please try again.
passwordRules: At least 10 characters, with a lower-case letter, an upper-case letter and a digit.
passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
passwordTooSimple: Include a lower-case letter, an upper-case letter and a digit.
passwordSame: Choose a password different from the current one.
passwordOffline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to change your password.
demoPasswordNote: Demo accounts share a public password, so it cannot be changed here.
tempPasswordBanner: You are using a temporary password. Tap here to choose your own.
accessBlockedBody: Your account was disabled or has not been set up. Ask your manager.
noCropsHint: No crops yet. Add your first crop so field staff can create lots.
